name: Hikari Festival
blurb: An Asian-culture festival in Poznań over the last weekend of summer, with anime, cosplay contests, idol concerts and workshops.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Festival 'Hikari Festiwal Kultury Azjatyckiej' 2027-08-27 -> 2027-08-29 @ Poznań; homepage banner text 'Hikari 27-29 sierpnia 2027, Poznań'.

notes: The homepage's guest slider is explicitly headed 'Gwiazdy Hikari 2026' (True/Miho Karasawa, Machico, R!N/Gemie, Kisu, Misa, Sabaku, Helper, Lon Cosplay) and a news post reads 'Koniec edycji 2026 przyszedł szybciej, niż byśmy chcieli' (the 2026 edition's end came too fast) — that lineup is last year's, so per the brief this is guests: none-yet for the announced 2027-08-27..29 edition rather than carrying those names forward. No venue named yet beyond the city.
